result.title: ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding
result.summary: 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练、查询条件化的多视图流程：先把查询分解为概念，经粗检索打分、多样性去冗余与按目标可见性/可回答性的重排序筛出少量图像，再做可选定位与自验证作答，并配套 judge 式评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心主张「瓶颈在于选出使查询可回答的视图而非更强的 3D 表示」与视觉证据筛选、证据充分性判断直接相关，可供核查 latent 推理中如何挑选与重排视觉证据；但论文未涉及内部 latent 状态与动态计算。
